parsed.post: Increased DEPTH to 6. Experiment val_bpb 1.016710 (vs 1.072838). Depth increase looks very promising for the 5-min window. Next: stack DEPTH 6 with WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY 0.01 to see if we can stabilize the capacity gains.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and adding WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 to stabilize the higher capacity model within the 5-minute budget.
